Complete wire proofs and wrong-iteration negative controls verified after timing. Not mainnet Grafana IPS or a 24-hour stability test. Default profiling off for comparisons.

Opt-in stage/CPU/core-sample instrumentation and natural request trace export
Opt-in 64-sample ASIC endpoint cache, invalidated on challenge reset and hardware restart; full verification unchanged
rejected: Hash challenge reuse in verifier: mixed sub-percent delivery changes
Proof priority boost with recomputation in background: large long-target regressions
Boosting both proof and intermediate workers: long-target regressions
One in-flight proof per engine: short-target regressions
